knowledge:
- key_parameters: win_size=Controls the window size (resolution) in base pairs when fetching signal data from bigWig files using ssvFetchBigwig ;; spline_n=Applies spline interpolation to smooth aggregated line plots in ssvSignalLineplotAgg ;; nclust=Specifies the number of clusters for k-means clustering in ssvSignalClustering and ssvSignalHeatmap ;; view_size=Controls the width of the genomic window centered around the maximum signal peak in centerAtMax ;; by_=Determines how regions are grouped or shifted in centerAtMax (e.g., "id" shifts regions individually, while NULL shifts them identically) ;; group_=Defines the metadata columns used to group data for aggregation in ssvSignalLineplotAgg
- alternatives: ChIPpeakAnno=Mentioned for annotating peak overlaps with genomic features (e.g., annotatePeakInBatch) ;; rtracklayer=Suggested for exporting/importing bedGraph or wig files to bigWig format (export.bw, import.bedGraph) ;; cowplot=Used for arranging and assembling multiple ggplot2 objects into a single figure
- when_to_use: Use when comparing multiple ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, or other genomic interval datasets to assess overlap reproducibility, cluster signal profiles across promoters/enhancers, or validate peak calls against continuous signal intensity.
- pitfalls: Windows OS Limitation=Reading bigWig formatted files will not work at all on Windows operating systems ;; Venn Diagram Limit=At release, ssvFeatureVenn is limited to displaying a maximum of 3 sets ;; Euler Diagram Complexity=Euler diagrams are approximations; computation time and inaccuracy increase rapidly with more sets ;; centerAtMax Overhangs=Centering regions at maximum signal causes overhangs that are trimmed by default, which reduces the final region size; users may need to extend original query GRanges beforehand ;; Scatterplot Overplotting=Using too many colors in scatterplots gets confusing quickly; it is recommended to limit color groups to the specific samples being plotted

workflows.name: peak_set_overlap_analysis
workflows.intent: Overlap multiple genomic interval sets (such as peak calls) and visualize their intersections using barplots, Venn diagrams, Euler diagrams, or binary heatmaps.
input: np_files (a named character vector of file paths to narrowPeak or BED files)
workflows.stages:
1. Load peak files into a list of GRanges using easyLoad_narrowPeak.
2. Overlap the interval sets to create a consensus GRanges object with membership metadata using ssvOverlapIntervalSets.
3. Extract the logical membership table using ssvMakeMembTable.
4. Visualize the overlaps using ssvFeatureBars, ssvFeatureVenn, ssvFeatureEuler, or ssvFeatureBinaryHeatmap.
workflows.code:
np_grs = easyLoad_narrowPeak(np_files)
olaps = ssvOverlapIntervalSets(np_grs)
ssvMakeMembTable(olaps)
ssvFeatureBars(olaps)
ssvFeaturePie(olaps)
ssvFeatureVenn(olaps)
ssvFeatureEuler(olaps)
ssvFeatureBinaryHeatmap(olaps)

workflows.name: genomic_signal_visualization_and_clustering
workflows.intent: Fetch continuous genomic signal from bigWig files over specified regions, cluster the profiles, and visualize them using line plots, heatmaps, scatter plots, or banded quantiles.
input: bw_files (a named character vector of file paths to bigWig files)
olaps (a GRanges object representing consensus genomic regions of interest)
workflows.stages:
1. Resize query regions to a uniform fixed width centered on the peaks using centerFixedSizeGRanges.
2. Fetch continuous signal data from bigWig files using ssvFetchBigwig.
3. Convert membership metadata into a grouping factor using ssvFactorizeMembTable.
4. Plot individual or aggregated signal profiles using ssvSignalLineplot and ssvSignalLineplotAgg.
5. Compare signal intensities between samples using ssvSignalScatterplot.
6. Visualize signal distribution using ssvSignalBandedQuantiles.
7. Cluster signal profiles using ssvSignalClustering and visualize with ssvSignalHeatmap.
8. Align profiles to local signal maxima using centerAtMax and re-cluster for improved visualization.
workflows.code:
olaps_fixedSize = centerFixedSizeGRanges(olaps, width_q75)
bw_gr = ssvFetchBigwig(file_paths = bw_files, qgr = olaps_fixedSize, win_size = 50)
olap_groups = ssvFactorizeMembTable(mcols(olap_gr))
ssvSignalLineplot(bw_data = subset(bw_gr, id %in% 1:12), facet_ = "facet_label")
ssvSignalLineplotAgg(bw_data = bw_gr)
ssvSignalLineplotAgg(bw_data = bw_gr, spline_n = 10)
ssvSignalScatterplot(bw_gr, x_name = "MCF10A_CTCF", y_name = "MCF10AT1_CTCF", color_table = olap_groups)
ssvSignalBandedQuantiles(bw_gr, by_ = "sample", hsv_grayscale = TRUE, hsv_symmetric = TRUE, hsv_reverse = TRUE)
clust_gr = ssvSignalClustering(bw_gr, nclust = 3, facet_ = "facet_label")
ssvSignalHeatmap(clust_gr, facet_ = "facet_label")
center_gr = centerAtMax(clust_gr, view_size = 150, by_ = "id", check_by_dupes = FALSE)
clust_center_gr = ssvSignalClustering(center_gr, nclust = 3)
ssvSignalHeatmap(clust_center_gr, facet_ = "facet_label")
